page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 4 dedicated vCPUs spanning 2 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores at 2.5 GHz with hyperthreading enabled. The instance includes 8.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core. Hardware instruction extensions include AVX-512 with VNNI, AES, FMA, and BMI2. The instance does not include bundled local storage or discrete GPUs, relying on external block storage, and provides a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations reflect an entry-level performance profile relative to modern cloud infrastructure. The Intel Xeon processor achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 1166 and a multi-core score of 2549. PassMark testing recorded a overall CPU score of 4254.87. Uncached memory bandwidth measured 26.23 GB/sec for large block reads and 22.85 GB/sec for writes. In application-specific testing, the server processed 3.38 million Redis SET operations per second and maintained a static web serving throughput of 3.84 GB/sec.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and compute-oriented 1:2 resource ratio, the instance provides predictable execution for non-memory-intensive workloads. The absence of local SSD storage requires network-attached storage configuration for persistent data requirements. Recommended workloads include light web serving, basic software compilation tasks, microservices, and small-scale batch data processing.
